claims.title: Reconstructive reproduction can retain developmental rules only when functional and material credit align

quoted_fields.interface: A reproductive founder branch inheriting the complete programme, regenerated indispensable specialists, an explicit product-to-reproduction objective, and bounded/charged inherited reserves and external material. Claimed conditional rules additionally require informative action-relevant cues with their assumed outcome dependence.
quoted_fields.failure: The complete current response starts at section 2; no missing section or timeout partial is spliced in. Numerical optima depend on a specified 12-worker Poisson/development model, not a general living learner. Weak cue gains can be overwhelmed by sensing cost/drift. Sensor-free repertoire growth uses expected population matrices and excludes rare-type extinction. Finite reproductive capacity reverses the example at budget B=13. Arbitrary externally valuable products need a separate causal feedback interface. No integrated living lineage is supplied.

claims.title: Oxygen-conditioned flow control needs explicit spatial, sensing, work and mechanical interfaces

quoted_fields.interface: Known fixed geometry and uptake law, nonnegative locally Newtonian viscosity and declared resource budget for the hydraulic result. The successor assumes the explicit Maxwell/output-spring topology, pressure-balanced port law, periodic drive, actual local/downstream-to-upstream oxygen information and acquired oxygen conversion kinetics, rather than substituting stress-relaxation time for ligand response.
quoted_fields.failure: These models omit major biological vessel/injury effects. Oxygen extraction alone cannot distinguish latent recoverability. Desired-sign rheology and hydrogel valves have antecedents; no broad novelty claim. The published very-low-oxygen material threshold is not a healthy-tissue setpoint. Thin ribbons preserve ideal axial stiffness and shorten diffusion paths but cannot remove ligand kinetic floor or oxygen inventory. An ordinary powered sensor/actuator has a different topology and need not obey the direct-transmission volume bound. No reopening of blocked vessels or tissue-recovery/clinical capability.
